title: NY Giants training camp: Will there be a competition at left guard?

sources.title: NY Giants training camp: Will there be a competition at left guard?
sources.description: For months now, there has been conversation about the idea that the New York Giants might release starting left guard Jon Runyan Jr. to open $9.25 million in salary cap space. First-team reps at the position were eyed carefully all spring to see if a competition was indeed brewing. With the exception of a few […]
